'''Ma'kis'shaalas''' was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Gender|male]] [[Jedi Knight]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. He attended meetings at the [[Jedi Temple communication center|briefing room]] in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] regarding updates on the [[Galactic Republic]]'s war with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Biography==
Ma'kis'shaalas, a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Gender|male]], was a [[Jedi Knight]]<ref name="VE" /> active during the [[Clone Wars]], which was the [[Galactic Republic]]'s conflict with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the war, Ma'kis'shaalas attended meetings in the [[Jedi Temple communication center|briefing room]] at the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[The galaxy|galactic]] [[capital]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="ROTS" />

In [[19 BBY]], the final [[Standard year|year]] of the war, Ma'kis'shaalas, alongside fellow [[Jedi]]<ref name="ROTS" /> [[Melik Galerha]], [[J'oopi Shé]], and [[Shadday Potkin]],<ref name="VE" /> attended a meeting in the Jedi briefing room regarding the Republic's [[Outer Rim Sieges|siege]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]]. The meeting was presented by [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] shortly before the [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] initiated [[Order 66]], which caused most [[clone trooper]]s to [[Death|eliminate]] their [[Jedi General]]s.<ref name="ROTS" />

==Personality and traits==
Ma'kis'shaalas had green [[eye]]s and light brown skin.<ref name="ROTS" /> He was disturbed when he saw Eeth Koth being tortured by Grievous.<ref name="VE" />

==Equipment==
Ma'kis'shaalas had a [[Color|blue bladed]] [[lightsaber]] and wore [[Jedi apparel|Jedi robes]].<ref name="VE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The episode guide for the ninth episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|season two]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' mentions a model being created for a Jedi named "Makis Shaalas."<ref name="Trivia gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/grievous-intrigue-trivia-gallery|text="Grievous Intrigue" Trivia Gallery}}</ref> This model was never confirmed to be Ma'kis'shaalas and is not seen in the episode.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref>
